name: Admissible but not monotone h: A* reopens C
note: h never overestimates (h(B) = 3 = h*(B)) but h(B) = 3 > k(B,C) + h(C) = 1 + 0, so h is not monotone. A* picks C early with g = 4 (f = 4) and closes it; later B offers C the cheaper g = 3, and C is REOPENED (watch the caption 'cheaper path via B ... reopened'). The result S-A-B-C-G = 5 is still optimal. Run the Admissibility & monotone check to see the edge B to C flagged.
